programme.title: The Tenpenny Podcasts - Becoming MomStrong in an Era of Cultural Indoctrination - The Tenpenny Podcasts - Motherhood Authority and the Fight for Children
programme.desc: The discussion moves into the daily reality of cultural conditioning from early exposure to sexual ideology to the normalization of beliefs that detach children from biological reality and parental authority Heidi speaks about patterns she has witnessed across states and generations describing how these ideas are introduced early reinforced systematically and defended aggressively when questioned The pressure culminates around responsibility Heidi returns repeatedly to the narrow window parents are given describing children as minds still forming impressions still malleable and time already running short She frames motherhood as a role that demands vigilance sacrifice and willingness to confront systems that claim authority over children who were never meant to be surrendered

programme.title: LifeTVnow - Change Your Mind Change Your Life
programme.desc:
In this episode of LifeTVnow Joe Horn and Jamie Woodle sit down with motivational speaker and clinical therapist Debbie Troeger to explore how the thoughts you rehearse every day shape your behaviors your health and ultimately your future Why do so many people set goals only to fall back into the same habits Is it really a lack of discipline—or is something deeper happening in the brain
Together they discuss
Why limiting beliefs keep us stuck How your thoughts influence your actions The science behind lasting behavior change Practical ways to develop healthier thinking patterns How faith and mindset work together to transform your life If youve ever felt trapped by fear negative thinking or repeated cycles that seem impossible to break this conversation offers practical encouragement and hope
Your circumstances dont always determine your future—but your mindset often does

programme.title: Patriots With Grit - Death Sentence Cancer Cured Without Chemo | Emma Victoria Johnson
programme.desc:
At just 43 years old Emma Victoria Johnson was diagnosed with Stage 4 breast cancer and told she had only 18 months to live Refusing conventional chemotherapy she chose an alternative path that changed everything
In this powerful Patriots With Grit interview Emma shares how she sought treatment at Oasis of Hope Hospital in Mexico the lifestyle changes she made the therapies she underwent and why she believes they saved her life
Whether you agree or disagree this is a remarkable story of courage hope and personal conviction that is inspiring conversations around the world

Joining Amber is Sam Anthony Owner and Founder of YourNewscom to discuss the stories the media coverage political accountability and what voters need to know
